outcome: cord blood oxidative stress markers (total nitric oxide, total hydroperoxide, biological antioxidant potential, oxidative stress index)
cord blood inflammatory markers (interleukin (IL)-1b, IL-6, IL-8, IL-10, tumor necrosis factor alpha, interferon gamma, and complement component C5a)
admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
finding: Elevated umbilical cord blood levels of oxidative stress index (OSI) and total hydroperoxide (TH) were associated with a higher risk of admission to the NICU.
